prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1323; do not mention it.)
text:
This letter confirms that our firm now represents the injured party in connection with the rear-end collision described in your file. Our client was hurt in the incident and is currently receiving care for injuries sustained as a result. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability policy limits applicable to the at-fault driver, along with a certified copy of the declarations page for that policy. Please also confirm the name of the adjuster assigned to this claim so that we may coordinate directly.

Finally, we ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to the collision. This includes photographs, vehicle damage appraisals, repair records, telematics or event data recorder information, recorded statements, claim notes, and any dash camera or surveillance footage. Please treat this request as a formal notice to preserve such materials until this claim is fully resolved.
